items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: I still think Sarah cuts everybody. ... like Leontyne Price and all that.

ctx.x: She's amazing, because her voice hasn't lost anything. On the contrary...
It's gotten better and better and better. She's the greatest on earth, I think. And that includes the Classicals, like Leontyne Price and all that. I still think Sarah cuts everybody.
